subject: Candidate update: overnight hotel quarantine — options for the loop
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@gmail.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:13:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview loop on Jul 7 — urgent

Hi Irene,

I'm so sorry to do this last minute. I'm currently stuck in a hotel near SFO — the flight was diverted overnight due to a cluster on the runway and the hotel is under a short quarantine for exposed passengers. I woke up with a scratchy throat and the hotel front desk has asked all affected guests to stay in their rooms for 48 hours while they monitor symptoms.

I don't want to risk anyone's time or health — would you be able to either (a) condense the loop into a single 60–75 minute virtual session later today if I'm feeling okay, or (b) move the interviews to early next week? I'm available Tue/Wed AM next week and can share my calendar. I'm very sorry for the disruption and appreciate the team's flexibility.

Attached my (very short) itinerary and the boarding pass stub — happy to share expenses if needed.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
San Francisco, CA

Attachment: itinerary-stub.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Interview loop on Jul 7 — urgent

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and I'm sorry that's happening. Hope you're ok.

We can definitely be flexible. Two options that would work for the panel today depending on how you're feeling:

- Condensed virtual loop (one 75-minute back-to-back session) starting 15:00 PT today — we'd aim for two 30-min interviews + 15-min debrief.
- Push to next week: Tue 07/13 or Wed 07/14 morning slots (09:00–11:30 PT) — pick whichever you prefer and we'll lock the panel.

If you think there's any chance you'll be symptomatic, please choose next-week slots and we'll move everything — no penalty. If you feel okay later and prefer the condensed loop, reply and I will send an updated calendar invite and 1-password test account for the takehome exercise portion.

I'll loop in the panel now to check availability and keep the options open. I attached a provisional invite (ICS) for the 15:00 compressed slot so you can see timing — we'll only send a final invite once you confirm.

Take care,
Irene Choi
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
O: (415) 555-0118
